name: run_command
description: Run a shell command or a multi-line shell script. Use background=true with a short title for long work: it returns a job_id at once, job(action=status) checks it, job(action=stop) kills it, and you are notified when it finishes. Inside a script, `miyu tool-call <name> --stdin` calls structured tools as this session; those run in the daemon-side session workspace and inherit neither the script's environment nor its working directory, so pass data through argument JSON or files.

command.description: The command or script. Prefer edit for file edits.

background.description: Detach and return a job_id. Use it above roughly 30 seconds.

title.description: Required. What the command is for, at most 16 characters (e.g. "release build"). The UI shows it instead of the command text, so a reader who cannot read shell still knows what is happening.
